sections.title: Course overview and tools
sections.question: The course map, the syllabus checklist and tools you will use in every unit.

materials.title: Two-Year Course Guide
materials.description: The route through our six units and four research practicals, with what each unit covers and where it sits in the IB syllabus.

materials.title: Complete Syllabus Checklist
materials.description: Every examinable term and learning objective, sorted by our six units. Tick each one when you can explain it and use it in an answer. Ticks stay on your device.

materials.title: Redemption Arc: Paper 1 Section C
materials.description: A timed 60-minute Paper 1 Section C essay (reinforcement and causality, or memory and measurement), with the markbands beside your writing and a PDF to hand in.

sections.title: Psychology as a Way of Thinking
sections.question: How do psychologists develop, test and evaluate explanations of behaviour?

sections.title: Learning, Bias and Decision-Making
sections.question: How do we learn, and why do our judgements go wrong?
sections.context: Learning and cognition: thinking and learning

materials.title: Escape the Loop: Operant Conditioning
materials.description: An escape room about reinforcement and punishment. Crack each room by applying operant conditioning, then hand in your PDF.

materials.path: Unit 2 Learning and Bias/Dual Process Theory and Cognitive Biases
materials.title: Two Minds: Dual Process Theory and Cognitive Biases
materials.description: Ten hands-on stations for group rotation: experience a cognitive bias, trace it back to System 1 and System 2, then teach it to a classmate with a head-to-head quiz.

sections.title: Memory, Models and the Brain
sections.question: How can we explain memory, investigate the brain and improve cognition?

materials.path: Unit 3 Memory and the Brain/Models of Memory
materials.title: Memory Lab: Models of Memory
materials.description: Take part in classic memory demonstrations, from sensory memory to serial position, and test what the multi-store model can and cannot explain.

materials.path: Unit 3 Memory and the Brain/Working Memory and Cognitive Load
materials.title: Memory Quest: Working Memory and Cognitive Load
materials.description: A story-driven lab: test your own working memory, replicate Landry and Bartling and Sana et al., and discover intrinsic, extraneous and germane cognitive load.

materials.title: Neural Lab: From Signals to Memory
materials.description: How neurons signal, a guided rat-maze model of acetylcholine and memory, and how drugs act at the synapse.

materials.path: Unit 3 Memory and the Brain/Environment and Memory
materials.title: Attention Lab: A Research Notebook
materials.description: Six guided studies on notifications, task switching and nearby screens. Predict, test yourself, then compare your result with the research.

materials.path: Unit 3 Memory and the Brain/Improving Memory
materials.title: Memory Olympiad
materials.description: Six randomised memory challenges with answer reviews and unlimited practice. Try strategies for improving memory and see what changes.

materials.path: Unit 3 Memory and the Brain/Odyssey Review
materials.title: Odyssey: The Long Way Home
materials.description: A voiced, branching Odyssey adventure that reviews the whole Learning and Cognition context for Paper 1: conditioning, social learning, schema theory, memory models, cognitive load, dual process theory and biases. Story mode, study mode and Paper 1 practice.

materials.path: Unit 3 Memory and the Brain/Mindvault Review
materials.title: Mindvault: Learning and Cognition Escape Room
materials.description: Nine quiz rooms on memory, the brain, conditioning, cognitive load, bias and the six concepts, then a notes workshop you can export.

sections.title: Influence, Identity and Connection
sections.question: How do groups and personal relationships shape behaviour?

sections.title: Mental Health, Behaviour Change and Culture
sections.question: How are mental health and health problems explained, addressed and prevented?

sections.title: Development Across Time
sections.question: How and why do people develop, and what shapes their sense of self?
